sonnet.problem: The setup on card 4 ('all the way to the flood') and the question itself ('Jesus compares His coming to the time of the flood') point straight to Noah. The wrong answers, Moses and Abraham, are ruled out because neither is tied to the flood.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: Card 11 asks whether Jesus gives 'the same picture' with two women. Card 10 already asked the 'one taken and the other left' point, and no card told the baker about the women, so the answer is a coin flip. The question re-asks the same point as card 10 in a parallel verse.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question.
